patch_description: Replace the global MAD-of-diffs sigma in the slope-consistency pass with a locally adaptive, vectorized rolling robust sigma computed over ±25-sample blocks of x_smooth diffs via sliding_window_view. Noisy non-stationary segments get aggressive snapping (smaller local sigma → more median blending) while clean segments with genuine dynamics get a larger local sigma and keep their full response. This directly targets lag_error (0.41) and avg_error (0.51) without sacrificing the reversal/slope gains (30 slope changes). Since the diff series of x_smooth is short-window available, we pad edge blocks via reflection to keep lengths aligned. The blend is slightly increased (0.5 → 0.6) for snapped samples to strengthen noise suppression where local noise dominates, exploiting the responsiveness margin (0.71).
